model: MicroTech Vision / Skyline EC Fan Array Controller
applies_to: Vision (CAH/CAC) and Skyline (OAH/OAC) air handlers with an EC fan array on the MicroTech 4 fan controller (Premium controls option), up to 20 fans.
summary: The MicroTech 4 fan array controller drives up to 20 EC fans (Delta, ebm-papst or Infinitum) over an internal Modbus bus and exposes the array on BACnet MS/TP (RS-485 port 2) or BACnet IP. Points cover demand, duct static and airflow setpoints, array speed, airflow and power, relay and input status, a unit alarm text, and per-fan speed, comm, fault, RPM and alarm-code objects. BACnet can only command the array when its Demand Source is set to BACnet at the HMI.
firmware: Application 2506990201 or later (PICS); DSP/CFM setpoint control needs application 2.1 or later
default_device_instance: Last 4 digits of the MT4 controller serial number
notes: Per-fan objects (AV 101-120, BV 11-30, BV 51-70, BV 101-120, MV 101-120) only exist for the configured number of fans.
Fan alarm code states (MV 101-120) differ by fan make: Delta, ebm-papst or Infinitum.
Active control needs Demand Source = BACnet (MV 5 reads BACnet); otherwise the BACnet objects are monitor-only.
DSP, CFM and fan tracking control are not in application 2.0 and earlier.
Total Fan Power (AV 5) is in kW but the object carries no units property.
Manual mode set at the HMI reverts to Normal after 60 minutes or a power cycle.

source.title: MicroTech Vision and Skyline EC Fan Array Controller - Network Integration Guide (BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP)

integration.summary: Set the Demand Source to BACnet at the fan controller HMI, then start and stop the array with Unit Control Mode (MV 23) and set capacity with Demand Setpoint (AV 11), or the duct static (AV 9) or airflow (AV 10) setpoint when the array runs in DSP or CFM mode. Read Unit State, fan speed, airflow and the alarm text and relay status.

minimum_points.name: UnitCtrlMode
minimum_points.why: Array Auto/Off command (Demand Source must be BACnet)

minimum_points.name: DmdSrc
minimum_points.why: Shows BACnet when the BMS has control

minimum_points.name: AvgFanSpd
minimum_points.why: Average speed of all fans, rpm

integration.enable: Demand Source must be configured as BACnet in the Config Array HMI menu (MV 5 shows it). With the HMI Control Mode at Auto, Unit Control Mode (MV 23) toggles the array between Auto and Off; Off at the HMI overrides BACnet. With HMI, 0-10 VDC or 4-20 mA as the demand source, BACnet is read-only monitoring.
integration.heartbeat: No receive heartbeat (listed as not applicable). BACnet values stay at the last valid value on communication loss; invalid network values fall back to defaults.
setup: Device instance defaults to the last 4 digits of the MT4 controller serial number; device name is MT4_DFA_<instance>.
BACnet MS/TP defaults: MAC 18, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 10.
BACnet IP defaults: 192.168.1.42 / 255.255.255.0, gateway 192.168.1.1, UDP 47808, DHCP off.
Set addressing in the HMI BMS Communications menus, then set Save Config to Yes; the controller restarts.
BACnet Units of Measurement (MV 18): SI, US (default) or CA.
gotchas: Demand, DSP, airflow and RPM setpoints are linked: writing one re-scales the others.
Out-of-range setpoint writes are ignored and the last valid value is kept.
Clear Alarms (MV 20) returns to No after about 3 s; alarms also clear on a power cycle and come back if the cause remains.
Fire alarm input (BI 1) and safety input (BI 3) read 0 when the alarm is active.
